name: Custom Formatters
description: Allows users to easily define custom Field Formatters.

suggests.drupal/codemirror_editor: Syntax-highlighted code editing for the PHP, HTML+Token, and Twig engines.
suggests.drupal/devel: Debug output for the preview feature and Devel Generate sample content.
suggests.drupal/field_tokens: Field-level token support, useful for HTML+Token formatters.
suggests.drupal/insert: Lets image/file/entity_reference formatters appear as Insert styles.
suggests.drupal/token: Token replacement for the HTML+Token formatter type.
